Multi-user hardening, smarter links and a lot of polish.

### 🚀 Features
- Links find notes by filename, and dead links say so.
- A note can be shared while it's open; shared notes say who they're shared with.
- Accounts get their own page; search covers everything, not only notes.
- See and start background jobs yourself.
- Crop your profile picture.
- The activity heatmap moves to Settings.
- AI assistant: pick from Ollama, OpenAI or Anthropic, with one-click local models.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Mentions are delivered wherever they were written.
- In-app dialogs replace browser pop-ups; search snippets fixed.

### 🔒 Security
- Data no longer leaks between accounts through the browser cache or git sync.
- Note cache and search index are scoped per account.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.1.0...v0.1.1](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1)
